   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9bf615c6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Applying a Trajectory-Based Channel in the Frequency and Time Domains\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook demonstrates how to apply a **NeoRadium** trajectory-based channel in both the frequency domain and the time domain. It first opens a [DeepMIMO](https://www.deepmimo.net) scenario, creates a random UE trajectory, and then creates a [TrjChannel](https://interdigitalinc.github.io/NeoRadium/html/source/API/Channels.html#neoradium.trjchan.TrjChannel) object from that trajectory.\n",
    "\n",
    "The notebook then creates a random transmit resource grid and applies the same channel in two different ways:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Frequency-domain channel application:** the channel matrix is obtained from the [TrjChannel](https://interdigitalinc.github.io/NeoRadium/html/source/API/Channels.html#neoradium.trjchan.TrjChannel) object and applied directly to the transmit resource grid.\n",
    "2. **Time-domain channel application:** the transmit resource grid is first converted to a waveform using OFDM modulation, the trajectory-based channel is applied to the waveform, and the received waveform is synchronized and demodulated back to a resource grid.\n",
    "\n",
    "Finally, the notebook compares the received resource grids from the two methods using the normalized mean squared error (NMSE).\n",
    "\n",
    "## Notes\n",
    "\n",
    "- This simple example applies the channel only at the first point of the trajectory. It does not advance the UE along the trajectory and does not loop over trajectory points.\n",
    "- No noise is added in this example. The goal is to compare the channel application methods, not to evaluate link performance.\n",
    "- The NMSE between the frequency-domain and time-domain received grids is expected to be small, but not necessarily exactly zero. The time-domain path includes OFDM modulation, channel filtering, timing synchronization, and OFDM demodulation, which can introduce small numerical differences.\n",
    "- The trajectory is generated from points on the DeepMIMO grid. The `trajLen` parameter refers to the number of DeepMIMO grid points used for the trajectory, not the final number of interpolated trajectory points.\n",
    "- The user may need to update the `dataFolder` variable based on the location of the DeepMIMO scenario files on their system."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "ff9c84c5",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import time\n",
    "\n",
    "from neoradium import DeepMimoData, TrjChannel, BandwidthPart, AntennaPanel, Modem, random\n",
    "from neoradium.utils import getNmse"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "bb2a83ef",

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Replace this with the folder on your system where the DeepMIMO scenarios are stored\n",
    "dataFolder = \"/data/RayTracing/DeepMIMO/Scenarios/V4/\"\n",
    "DeepMimoData.setScenariosPath(dataFolder)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a DeepMimoData object\n",
    "deepMimoData = DeepMimoData(\"asu_campus_3p5\")\n",
    "deepMimoData.print()"
   ]
  },

      "  Total time:             7.967 seconds\n",

      "  Paths (Min, Avg, Max):  5, 8.79, 10\n",

     ]
    },
    {

      ]

     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"

   ],
   "source": [
    "random.setSeed(123)                                 # Make results reproducible\n",
    "bwp = BandwidthPart(numRbs=24, spacing=15)          # Create a BandwidthPart object\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a random trajectory\n",
    "trajectory = deepMimoData.getRandomTrajectory(xyBounds=np.array([[-210, 40], [-120, 100]]),   # Trajectory bounds\n",
    "                                              segLen=5,     # Number of DeepMIMO grid points on the shortest segment\n",
    "                                              bwp=bwp,      # The bandwidth part\n",
    "                                              trajLen=200,  # Number of DeepMIMO grid points on the trajectory\n",
    "                                              speedMps=30)  # Speed in m/s\n",
    "\n",
    "trajectory.print()                                  # Print the trajectory information\n",
    "ax = deepMimoData.drawMap(\"LOS-NLOS\", trajectory)   # Draw the map with the trajectory\n",
    "deepMimoData.drawBsPanel(ax, 180)                   # TX antenna at a 180-degree bearing angle"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "637aee7e-cec6-4733-985f-c6ae585a131a",
   "metadata": {},

    {

      "    Phases (Deg):     -39   102   115   -58   162   36    -161 \n",
      "    AOAs (Deg):       6     3     2     9     -2    -27   -27  \n",

      "    AODs (Deg):       -174  -173  -172  -178  -172  -151  -151 \n",

   "source": [
    "# Print the properties of the first trajectory point\n",
    "trajectory[0].print()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "96a6d10c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Resource grid shape: (16, 14, 288)\n",
      "Waveform shape:      (16, 30720)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create a random resource grid\n",
    "txGrid = bwp.createGrid(numPorts=16)                   # Create an empty resource grid\n",
    "\n",
    "stats = txGrid.getStats()                              # Get statistics about the grid\n",
    "modem = Modem(\"16QAM\")                                 # Use 16QAM modulation\n",
    "numRandomBits = stats['UNASSIGNED']*modem.qm           # Total number of bits available in the resource grid\n",
    "\n",
    "bits = random.bits(numRandomBits)                      # Create random bits\n",
    "symbols = modem.modulate(bits)                         # Modulate the bits to get symbols\n",
    "\n",
    "indices = txGrid.getReIndexes(\"UNASSIGNED\")            # Indices of the \"UNASSIGNED\" resources\n",
    "txGrid[indices] = symbols                              # Put symbols in the resource grid\n",
    "\n",
    "txWaveform = txGrid.ofdmModulate()                     # OFDM-modulate the resource grid to get a waveform\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Resource grid shape:\", txGrid.shape)\n",
    "print(\"Waveform shape:     \", txWaveform.shape)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "a6232005",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n",
      "TrjChannel Properties:\n",
      "  carrierFreq:              3.5 GHz\n",
      "  normalizeGains:           True\n",
      "  normalizeOutput:          True\n",
      "  normalizeDelays:          True\n",

      "  RX Antenna:\n",
      "    Total Elements:         4\n",
      "    spacing:                0.5𝜆, 0.5𝜆\n",
      "    shape:                  1 rows x 2 columns\n",
      "    polarization:           x\n",
      "  Trajectory:\n",
      "    start (x,y,z):          (-164.55, 69.83, 1.50)\n",
      "    No. of points:          7,968\n",
      "    curIdx:                 0 (0.00%)\n",
      "    curSpeed:               [21.28 21.28  0.  ]\n",
      "    Total distance:         240.42 meters\n",
      "    Total time:             7.967 seconds\n",
      "    Average Speed:          30.177 m/s\n",
      "    Carrier Frequency:      3.5 GHz\n",
      "    Paths (Min, Avg, Max):  5, 8.79, 10\n",
      "    Totally blocked:        0\n",
      "    LOS percentage:         59.43%\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create a trajectory-based MIMO channel model\n",
    "channel = TrjChannel(bwp, trajectory,\n",
    "                     txAntenna = AntennaPanel([2,4], polarization=\"x\"), # 16 TX antennas\n",
    "                     txOrientation = [180,0,0],                         # BS antenna facing the left side of the map\n",
    "                     rxAntenna = AntennaPanel([1,2], polarization=\"x\"), # 4 RX antennas\n",
    "                     seed=123)\n",
    "print(channel)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "2a3063ed-0d9a-4f44-a517-91f0a25de7e5",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Time to apply the channel in the frequency domain (s): 0.0118\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Apply the channel in the frequency domain\n",
    "t0 = time.monotonic()\n",
    "channelMatrix = channel.getChannelMatrix()\n",
    "rxGridF = txGrid.applyChannel(channelMatrix)\n",
    "t1 = time.monotonic()\n",
    "print(f\"Time to apply the channel in the frequency domain (s): {t1-t0:.04f}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "46a2db3c-2ae5-43cd-851a-9007ba11690b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Time to apply the channel in the time domain (s): 0.1837\n",
      "NMSE between the rxGrid in time and frequency domains: 9.404e-18\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Apply the channel in the time domain and demodulate the received waveform to get a resource grid\n",
    "t0 = time.monotonic()\n",
    "maxDelay = channel.getMaxDelay()                         # Calculate the maximum channel delay\n",
    "paddedTxWaveform = txWaveform.pad(maxDelay)              # Pad the waveform with zeros\n",
    "rxWaveform = channel.applyToSignal(paddedTxWaveform)     # Apply the channel to the waveform\n",
    "offset = channel.getTimingOffset()                       # Get the timing offset for synchronization\n",
    "syncedWaveform = rxWaveform.sync(offset)                 # Synchronize the received waveform\n",
    "rxGridT = syncedWaveform.ofdmDemodulate(bwp)             # OFDM-demodulate the synchronized waveform\n",
    "t1 = time.monotonic()\n",
    "print(f\"Time to apply the channel in the time domain (s): {t1-t0:.04f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"NMSE between the rxGrid in time and frequency domains: {getNmse(rxGridT.grid,rxGridF.grid):.04g}\") \n"
   ]
  },
  {
